_about: B83: the allow rules in ~/projects/.claude/settings.json reach the unattended runs (--setting-sources project keeps the project's CLAUDE.md and skills, /build among them, and with them its settings file). Each rule here was read on the date below and is either taken back by a deny in settings.request.json / settings.build.json / settings.common.json or kept on purpose. `todo doctor` warns about any project allow rule that isn't listed, so a rule Taylor adds later gets the same look before an unattended run relies on it. User and local settings never load in these runs.

mcp__playwright.request: kept for the read-only browser tools; run_code_unsafe, file_upload, evaluate, fill_form, webmcp_call denied

Bash(shot *).request: kept; runs with SHOT_SANDBOX=1 (paths stay inside ~/projects, no private addresses)

Bash(./relay.py *).build: kept; refund, upgrade, credit, paywall, apps approve/deny, stripe, backup restore, walkthrough, demo on, send denied

Bash(site *).build: kept (a client site publish is part of a client row); SITE_ADMIN=1 denied

Bash(gh pr create *).build: kept; any command naming a key file is denied by path

Bash(gh pr merge *).build: kept: shipping is the build's job (skill § 7); --admin denied. The residual H2 risk; O6 is the account half

Bash(systemctl --user restart relay-*).build: denied (the build restarts through ./relay.py queue restart)
